name: Abdirizak Haji Hussein
legacy: During his tenure this person spearheaded reforms that strove to uproot corruption and pushed to make the republic's institutions more accountable.

checks.lead: Abdirizak Haji Hussein (Somali: Cabdirisaaq Xaaji Xuseen; Arabic: عبد الرزاق حاجي حسين‎; 24 December 1924 – 31 January 2014) was a Somali diplomat and politician. He was the Prime Minister of Somali Republic from 14 June 1964 to 15 July 1967.
